summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository, without committing or running any code. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and extends ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the formatter for the title sequence (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod with docstring; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor, returning True when the control is written and False when not a terminal, with a Google-style docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (console, skipped on Windows), test_control_title (control segment and control list), and test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only renderer test with mocked set_title). Not verified: tests, Black, and mypy were not run, per instructions; checks were by reading only. Choices made: the renderer calls the existing wrapper method set_title; the flush logic was left unchanged because the existing code already drops control segments when not a terminal and routes legacy Windows standard-stream output through the renderer.
